title: Common Python question routing
summary: Map a practical question to an authoritative area and a verification action.

examples.question: Why is this mutable default reused?
examples.verify: call twice and inspect object identity/state

examples.question: What does is mean here?
examples.route: data model -> identity; not merely style guidance

examples.question: Can dict iteration order be relied on?
examples.verify: run target version and cite the versioned reference

examples.question: What can Path.read_text raise?
examples.route: Library Reference -> pathlib.Path.read_text plus underlying documented exceptions

examples.question: Will this import resolve?
examples.verify: print module spec/path in the target environment
